title: Cursed AI Images: 12 Weird Pictures and Prompts
summary: 12 cursed AI images made in Flick with the prompt behind each: a cake as the groom, an eight-legged cat, a sea in a bathtub. Copy one and make your own.
body_markdown:
### What are cursed AI images?


Cursed AI images are AI-generated pictures that look like normal photos but contain something strange, wrong or uncanny, such as an animal with too many legs or a wedding where the groom is a cake, which makes them unsettling and funny at once.


### Why are they called cursed images?


The name comes from an internet trend of real photos that felt eerie or wrong for reasons that are hard to explain, often low quality flash photos of ordinary rooms. AI made it easy to create new ones on purpose, with the wrong detail written into the prompt.


### How do I make a cursed image with AI?


Describe an ordinary photo, such as a phone snapshot or a flash photo of a kitchen, then add one impossible detail and ask for a deadpan tone, so the picture looks real and the strange part stands out.


### What are good prompts for cursed AI images?


Good cursed image prompts name a plain kind of photo, one impossible swap and a calm reaction, such as a school class photo with a fridge in a jumper in the back row, or a bathtub holding a stormy ocean.


### Are cursed images scary?


They do not have to be. Cursed images can be creepy, but the funniest ones are just a little wrong, and adding no gore and no horror to the prompt keeps the weirdness playful.


### Can I turn a cursed image into a video?


Yes. Use the picture as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe one small movement, such as the eggs raising their eyebrows or the snail inching forward, with the camera still.


### Is it free to make cursed AI images in Flick?


Yes, you can start free: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made every picture on this page, costs 5 credits an image at its default settings.
